name: contact-panel
title: Contact panel
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A side panel with Details and Copilot tabs, a contact card, editable fields, and collapsible sections.

meta.descriptionEs: Pestañas Detalles y Copiloto, ficha del contacto y secciones plegables.

examples.title: Ficha de contacto
examples.description: Copiloto es un hueco para tarjetas que ya tengas.

api.name: tab / onTabChange
api.description: Arrow keys move between the two tabs.

api.name: fields
api.description: A select when options are set. Otherwise the value is read-only.

api.name: copilot
api.description: Rendered on the Copilot tab. The panel does not fetch suggestions.

docs: The Copilot tab is a slot, so hosts can drop in suggestion-card or tool-call without this item depending on them. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, collapsible, or separator. The item ships no theme.
